backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister with an empty actor definition.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature reports linking portfolio UI requirements to specific frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains short summaries of key frontend files including App, global CSS, and Tailwind config.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base file defining theme variables, dark mode tokens, and basic background/foreground styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main portfolio UI component rendering the profile photo header and all content sections with pastel styling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, loading, login, logout, and identity state management.
frontend/src/index.css: Global pastel-themed OKLCH color variables and typography rules for the portfolio’s minimal design.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry file initializing QueryClient, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended color system using CSS variables, custom animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata for a single‑page portfolio site, including existing features, pending requests, architectural notes, and known issues for build planning.
